recommendations.title: Review the documented steps for reconnecting managed instances after an upgrade
recommendations.action: Check the documented steps for reconnecting managed Core instances after a Central Management upgrade.
recommendations.rationale: Two of five instances went disconnected right after the upgrade while three stayed connected, which points at a per-instance connection state rather than the whole server.

recommendations.title: Pin down the version and upgrade date before advising
recommendations.action: Get the exact version from the About page and the upgrade date so the right release notes and steps apply.
recommendations.rationale: The customer gave 7.5.2 and later said 7.4.2, and named both Sunday and Saturday as the upgrade day; the audio was poor in parts, so none of this is reliable yet.
